desc: 深蓝哑光墙配米白台阶，冷调轮廓光逐片讲清腰贴结构、立体护围与膜感棉柔之别
leaf: 超薄透气芯体婴儿纸尿裤
name: 超薄芯体裸感婴儿纸尿裤款

shots.intent: 冷调深蓝墙切出高辨识度主图，三秒认出超薄腰贴式形态。
shots.textZone: top 28 percent of the navy wall reserved for headline, upper-left clear

shots.intent: 先放大厚重下坠的穿着负担，为后面的超薄结构留出反差。
shots.textZone: upper 25 percent navy band for the pain headline, left-aligned

shots.intent: 左膜右柔的双联微距，把外层膜感与内层棉柔手感一次讲清。
shots.textZone: bottom 22 percent off-white band for two short labels

shots.intent: 腰贴与弹力腰围是本品第一结构识别点，特写证明做工与贴合逻辑。
shots.textZone: left 34 percent navy clear zone for callout leader lines

shots.intent: 侧剖微距把芯体薄度与外层膜感做成可感知的厚度语言，不用任何数字。
shots.textZone: top 26 percent navy band for one headline and one label

shots.intent: 以成人托抱的婴儿背影交代真实穿着状态，建立安心使用联想。
shots.textZone: upper-left 30 percent navy clear zone for headline

shots.intent: 四宫格图标把表层、吸收、贴合、腰围四项结构特性排成可扫读的信任块。
shots.textZone: header band headline top-center, one label under each of the four tile icons

shots.intent: 平铺、折起、侧立三态并排，买家按习惯挑款不纠结。
shots.textZone: bottom 20 percent off-white band for three short labels

shots.intent: 回到主视觉角度收口，用大面积留白承载行动文案结束浏览。
shots.textZone: upper-left clean navy area for headline and a short action line

style.backgroundSystem: matte deep-navy wall #16233C behind a warm off-white stepped platform #F3EEE3, seamless studio depth, matte non-reflective planes, no visible horizon seam, no gradient sky
style.direction: cool navy premium baby-care ecommerce, editorial studio campaign
style.iconSystem: mustard-yellow #D8A62E square bracket enclosing one single vertical bar, uniform 4px stroke, flat vector, square terminals, one icon per tile, no fills, no emoji, no 3D bevel
style.lightingSystem: cool 5900K side-back key raking across the product, clean bright rim light tracing every silhouette edge, soft grounded contact shadow, gentle falloff into the navy wall, no warm cast, no flat frontal flash
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool navy premium baby-care ecommerce visual system across the entire set; fixed palette of deep navy #16233C, off-white #F3EEE3, fog blue-grey #5C6B85 and one mustard-yellow accent #D8A62E; cool 5900K side-back key with a bright clean rim light tracing the silhouette; matte deep-navy wall #16233C behind an off-white matte stone step #F3EEE3; one modern geometric sans-serif family; a mustard-yellow #D8A62E square bracket enclosing one vertical bar as the only icon style; stable product scale and centered placement with real contact shadows; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no palette changes, hex values only, never color adjectives
no mixed fonts, no serif, no handwritten, no cartoon lettering
no random backgrounds, no gradient sky, no beige studio backdrop
no inconsistent lighting, no warm-key shot inside the cool set
no mismatched icon styles, no filled or 3D icons
no brand name, logo, watermark, QR code, member badge or store name
no price, discount, coupon, delivery time, rating or sales count
no absorbency volume, no dry-hours figure, no breathability percentage, no thickness or weight number
no material composition or fiber grade, no origin or import claim, no patent count
no certificate, award, lab name, test report, registration or standard number
no medical or skin-rash prevention claim, no doctor or hospital endorsement
no age range, no weight range, no pack count, no size letters
baby always shot from behind or cropped above the jawline and always held by an adult
no diaper-change process, no baby alone, no naked infant
style.presentationRules: product centered on a stable vertical axis, one consistent 3/4 hero angle reused across the set, scale locked between shots, product never floats and never gets cropped at the bottom, straight edges stay vertical, one real reference object present in scene shots to anchor scale
style.surfaceSystem: off-white matte stone step #F3EEE3 with fine even grain, plus one matte fog-blue-grey #5C6B85 riser block for elevation, contact shadows always present, no mirrored floor
style.typography: one single modern geometric sans-serif family, uniform medium weight, off-white #F3EEE3 headline on the navy wall and navy #16233C headline on the off-white step, generous letter spacing, no second typeface, no serif, no handwritten, no cartoon
